chapter: The craft of the ad lib player
title: Bassists who play high in the register
summary: Hall says a bassist must supply the bass note and players in the horn register are performers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: What do you think about the -- the school of bass players that's come up in the later period, maybe beginning with someone like Scott LaFaro, who started playing higher up on the bass, and now we have a lot of players who, you know, who handle the bass like it's --
Like it's a guitar almost sometimes.

Well, I don't consider that bass. In my teaching I tell my Mike Slattery, you know, you can't have a penthouse without a bass note, and you're got to have the bass note. So everything else is in between. You're a

performer rather than a player then. If you played a bass, you're supposed to play the bass fiddle. A whole lot of guys rely upon that. The rest of the horns rely upon that. But if you're on top, in the same register that they are, you're just a performer.
